sheet.name: Winged Nightmare

traits.name: Regional Lair
traits.text: The Winged Nightmare’s Lair changes depending on the Kingdom. See your Kingdom Book for Setup instructions.

traits.name: Unpredictable Nature
traits.text:
The Winged Nightmare has 1 two-sided BP card. It starts the Clash with the Wide Wings side up. This BP remains in the same place during the Clash, regardless of Wounding or Failing. You cannot flip it using abilities. When you deal a Wound, place a Generic Single Wound card on the Wound Stack instead.

AI Response: Immediately resolve the “AI Response” effect of the top card of the AI discard pile. Triggers during Knight Attacks.
If, at any point, the AI discard pile is empty, discard the top AI card.
Escalate only the AI deck and always do so based on the AI Level of the top card of the AI discard pile.

traits.name: Fight and Flight
traits.text:
Flank: The Winged Nightmare moves to an empty space furthest from the center of the Clash Board that is adjacent to the Target or Attacker, prioritizing spaces in a straight line from a Chasm Terrain tile.

Flee X: The Winged Nightmare moves X spaces toward the closest Board Edge. If it already is or becomes adjacent to it, continue the movement along the Board Edge toward the next closest Board Edge.

When you resolve an AI Response, if the Attacker is at the Winged Nightmare’s Rear, ignore Flank and Flee X.

traits.name: Marble Forest
traits.text: As a free action, or instead of a Reflex, Knights may climb adjacent Column Terrain tiles. When a Knight is about to suffer Knockdown or involuntary movement while on a Column Terrain tile, they are Displaced and suffer Crash instead.

traits.name: Tougher than She Looks
traits.text: Endure X: The Winged Nightmare gains X temporary positive AT [AT] tokens.

traits.name: Siren’s Spite
traits.text: If the Winged Nightmare moves off a Column Terrain tile, that tile is destroyed.

traits.name: Bloody Defiance
traits.text:
The Winged Nightmare cannot die from Wounds. When you deal the final Wound, immediately place the Bloody Defiance BP Trait card on top of the BP card and resolve its Response instead. Until the end of the Clash, Knights attack this BP Trait card instead.

Ignore this Trait during Exhibition Clashes.

traits.name: Nixie’s Fury
traits.text:
During the Knight Round, when the second Knight ends their turn, draw and perform an AI card.

! For the purpose of this Trait treat dead Knights as empty turns. In other words, a dead Knight still counts as a Knight for the 2 Knight turn limit.

traits.name: Coiling Malice
traits.text: When the Winged Nightmare moves through a Knight, that Knight suffers Crash.
